site.title: Ronald (glitchbytez) — Java Developer
site.description: Java developer building dependable backend systems, with a networking and IT support background.

person.positioning: Java developer who builds dependable backend systems, with a networking and IT support background.
bio: I'm Ronald, a Java developer who likes building backend systems that are simple, reliable and easy to reason about. My background spans software development and hands-on IT support and networking, and I'm currently working towards my CCNA.

I work mostly with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Azure, and I care about the details that make software pleasant to live with: clear APIs, honest documentation and code that fails gracefully. Away from the keyboard I enjoy quiet design and a good book.

contact.line: If you're hiring, or just want to talk about backend systems, networks or a good book, I'd be glad to hear from you.

projects.title: Splitwise-style Expense Splitter
projects.summary: A backend for splitting shared expenses among groups of friends, built API-first with Java and Spring Boot.
projects.problem: Shared costs get messy fast. The goal is to track who paid, who owes whom, and how to settle up with the fewest payments.
highlights: JWT-secured REST API with registration, login and user profiles
Group and membership model with role-based rules, backed by PostgreSQL and Flyway migrations
Dockerised local setup with OpenAPI docs via springdoc-openapi
projects.next: Expenses with equal, exact and percentage splits, balances, settlements and debt simplification
